what: the text every loss in this exercise is measured on, frozen
why_frozen: AGENTS.md is edited on most pull requests. Reading it at run time made every published loss a function of a moving file: the run behind results/training.json read 92,021 bytes and the live file is now larger, so re-running today produces different numbers and nothing goes red. Freezing the exact revision the published run read makes the digest recomputable from the repository alone, which is what turns a recorded hash into a check.
never_edit: These bytes are a measured input, not prose. Editing a word here changes a published result rather than a document. If a lexical gate ever flags this file, add a path exemption naming it -- never reword it.
